accessibility.text: Context: In a given city, officials are concerned about the mental well-being of residents due to various stress factors like unemployment, crime, housing issues, etc. They have survey data from residents across the city, where each individual has rated their stress level and provided their address (or geolocation     ).
Example-Monitoring Mental Health in Different Neighborhoods
© Zahra Shakeri, Dalla Lana School of Public Health, University of Toronto
The main idea is to divide a set of data points into ￼ distinct clusters where each data point belongs to the cluster with the closest mean.
